Hi James,

Thanks for checking in. Your order Shop···· is paid, and the US Airsquitter (4DSKY) with the bonus antenna ships October 31. That is the corrected date we wrote to you about on October 5, after the checkout date of October 3 turned out to be wrong on our side. Sorry again for that mix-up.

The unit is allocated to you in the end of October batch, and the warehouse is waiting on that batch to be checked in before it goes out. Your Harlo OS Diagnostics plus 3-month RMA goes in the same shipment. You can follow that incoming batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Dates there can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses, but October 31 is what your order carries today.

Tracking will come to this email address as soon as the label is printed. It is worth adding us to your contacts so it does not land in spam.

Anything else I can check for you, just reply here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
